payload.ambiguity_rule: AMBIGUOUS is a registered legitimate outcome of this question, not a failure to resolve it. Will's row-68 ruling states in terms that (d) INDETERMINATE is a legitimate outcome of a frozen spec and not a defect to patch mid-flight. DO NOT collapse branch (d) into NO: NO is reserved for branch (b), which is a directional falsifier asserting gold broke DOWN through 4050.00 while yields held at or above 2.40, and reading an indeterminate grade as NO would assert a falsification the letter does not support. DO NOT resolve YES on the gold leg alone; the binding leg is DFII10 versus 2.40 and it is the leg that fails on current readings. DO NOT substitute a nearby DFII10 print for the 2026-08-28 observation to escape an indeterminate grade. If the gold settlement is at or above 4340.70 on one basis and below it on the other, that disagreement is itself branch (d) and resolves AMBIGUOUS. Ties resolve INTO the branch: 'at or above' includes exact equality at 4340.70 and at 2.40, and the letter's own record notes the 2026-08-21 observation of exactly 2.40 satisfied the leg.
annulment_rules: Annul only if FRED and the Federal Reserve H.15 release permanently cease to publish the 10-year Treasury inflation-indexed constant-maturity series and no successor series preserves the 2026-08-28 observation, such that the yield leg can never be read on any basis.

Annul only if COMEX gold settlement records for trade date 2026-08-28 become permanently unavailable from both the exchange and the registered fallback, such that the gold leg cannot be read on any basis.
payload.claim: MIDAS-06 resolves branch (a) of its frozen letter: on the readings the letter names for 2026-08-28, the COMEX gold front-month settlement is at or above 4340.70 US dollars per troy ounce AND the FRED DFII10 observation dated 2026-08-28 is at or above 2.40 percent, so the gold / real-yield divergence (the debasement premium) is a durable reassertion rather than a mean-reverting melt-up.
payload.fallback_resolution_source: For the yield leg, the Federal Reserve H.15 release archive for the statement week containing 2026-08-28, which is the primary publication FRED redistributes. For the gold leg, the CME Group daily settlement record for the named contract month, cross-checked against the GLD closing price as a direction-only corroborant that is NOT unit-matched to the futures basis and never substitutes for a settlement.
payload.resolution_condition: Resolves YES if and only if BOTH legs of the letter's branch (a) hold: the COMEX gold front-month settlement for trade date 2026-08-28 is >= 4340.70 USD/oz AND the FRED DFII10 observation DATED 2026-08-28 is >= 2.40 percent. Resolves NO if and only if the letter's branch (b) holds: that gold settlement is < 4050.00 USD/oz while the same DFII10 observation is >= 2.40 percent. Resolves AMBIGUOUS if the letter's branch (c) holds (that DFII10 observation is < 2.20 percent, which the letter VOIDS as a divergence test and calls NO-CALL) or its branch (d) holds (any combination the first three branches do not cover, which the letter calls INDETERMINATE).
